basis: GLEIF states that data available through its Access Service are provided under CC0 1.0; this admission is limited to the RR-CDF Concatenated File.
notes: This rule admits only the GLEIF Level 2 RR-CDF Concatenated File.
Reporting Exceptions remain a separate dataset and are not admitted by this rule.
Re-check if source terms, license metadata, publisher identity, format, or access method changes.
